Greetings, Agents.

 

This is CM Fragment of MARVEL Future Fight.

 

To save a world from danger,
a group of cruel yet deadly dark heroes have come together
to form a completely new team!

 

In this Update Details, we are introducing the August Update,
featuring the Savage Avengers inspired theme.

 

New Uniforms have been added for the brutal and merciless members of the Savage Avengers,
Ghost Rider, Juggernaut, and Doctor Voodoo.
Juggernaut, who possesses overwhelming power to crush his enemies,
and Doctor Voodoo, a master of voodoo magic who can control souls, 
have also received Tier-4 Advancements.

 

Additionally, Black Knight, the wielder of the cursed weapon “Ebony Blade,”
has joined MARVEL Future Fight with a new Tier-3 Advancement.

 

We’ve also added a new Lobby Theme change feature
that allows you to change the game’s main screen.

 

Other improvements to make the game more enjoyable have been added as well, 
so please check the details below!

 

 

 

▣ One New Hero

 

Check out the abilities of Black Knight <Savage Avengers>, 
a renowned swordsman and wielder of the legendary Ebony Blade, 
a weapon said to be able to cut through anything.
* The skill effects of the new hero are based on the maximum skill level stats.

 

 


▣ Three New Uniforms

 

To celebrate the Savage Avengers inspired update, three new Uniforms have been added.
Check out the abilities of Ghost Rider <Savage Avengers>, Juggernaut <Savage Avengers>,
and Doctor Voodoo <Savage Avengers>.
* The skill effects of the new Uniforms are based on the maximum skill level stats.
* The three new Uniforms will be on sale for 40% off during the <August Update Celebration Event> and can be checked and purchased in the Marvel Universe and Uniform Room after the Event.

 

 

 

 

 

▣ Juggernaut & Doctor Voodoo Tier-4

 

Juggernaut, who cannot be stopped by physical means,
and Doctor Voodoo, who can use voodoo magic and supernatural abilities,
have received Tier-4 Advancements.
* The Tier-4 Striker Skill effects are based on Lv.6 stats.

 

 

 

 

▣ Black Knight Tier-3

 

Black Knight has received a Tier-3 Ultimate Skill.
This new power will aid him on his quest to restore the honor of his great warrior lineage.

 

 

 

 

▣ Daisy Johnson, Mockingbird, and Agent 13 Potential Awakening & Transcendence


Daisy Johnson, Mockingbird, and Agent 13 will acquire
Potential Awakening & Transcendence through the August Update!
* The skill effects are based on Lv.6 stats.

 

 

 

 

 

 

▣ New Lobby Theme Change Feature

 

We're excited to announce a brand-new feature: “Lobby Theme Change Feature”! 

 

Now you can customize the main screen of MARVEL Future Fight, 
the first place you visit and where you get ready for battle. 

 

Check out the in-game Store to browse a variety of new “Lobby Themes”, 
designed to give your lobby a fresh look and feel.

 

 

- Each background theme can be purchased with Gold, Crystals, and other currencies.

 


▣ New Artifacts

 

After the August update, Exclusive Passive Skill Artifacts for Black Knight, Daisy Johnson, Mockingbird and Agent 13 will be added.
﻿* The skill effects are based on Lv.4 stats.

 

 


▣ New Future Pass Plus Season & Special Icons

 

A new and improved Future Pass Plus season will begin after the update.
① The new Future Pass Plus offers 150% more Gold and materials than the previous Future Pass.
② Purchasing the Legendary / Mythic Pass Plus enables you to earn an Advanced Potential Transcendence Ticket, and a Tier-4 Advancement Ticket.

 

[Future Pass Plus Rewards]

 


- The Future Pass Plus effects will apply immediately upon purchase and cannot be refunded.
- Future Pass Plus - Legendary / Mythic that has been unlocked will only be applied during the season the Pass was purchased. 
The Pass rewards will only be available during the same season.
- The Future Pass Plus - Mythic can be purchased after purchasing the Future Pass Plus - Legendary.
- Future Pass Plus - Legendary / Mythic will not be available for purchase when the season is about to end. 
Please check the sale schedule in the game.

 

​​New Special Icons that will represent Agents have been added.
Collect two new Icons as Future Pass Plus rewards, and one more from the upcoming Event!

 

[August Update New Special Icon]

 

 

  

 

 

▣ New Uniform Collection


Check out the new Uniforms inspired by Savage Avengers.
Complete the collection by achieving the specified conditions and earn a reward.

 

 

 

▣ Update Hot Deal Products & Loyalty Point Reward Renewal

 

1. Update Hot Deal products have been added.
- Event Schedule: 
After the 8/19 Maintenance - 9/16 (Tue) 14:59 (UTC+0),
After the 8/19 Maintenance - 9/16 (Tue) 7:59 (PDT)
- Find various update celebration products like Hot Deal! 100M Gold Pack, and Hot Deal! Custom Gear Unequip Pack in the Hot Deals category in the Store.
Please check the details in-game after the update.

 

 

2. The Loyalty Point rewards earned when purchasing products will be renewed as follows.
- Planned date for renewal: 8/31 (Sun) 15:00 (UTC+0), 8/31 (Sun) 8:00 (PDT)

 


3. The Web Shop and In-game Store products have been revamped.
You can check the details by following the link below.
Go to → [Advance Notice of Major Renewal to Agent Supplies and Products]

 


▣ Other Improvements and Changes

 

1. Story: Following improvements have been made for more convenient stage progression.

 

① The Auto-Progress feature has been improved to allow you to seamlessly progress through all themes, rather than having to manually start each theme.

 

 

② Ultimate Mode: Some of the stage special bonus effects in certain stages have been adjusted.

 

 

2. Timeline Battle: The list of items available in the Token Shop has been revamped.
* The quantity and prices of each item have been adjusted to reflect the Token Shop renewal.

 

 

3. Character Level Up: A sorting feature has been added to the character level up screen (using Biometrics / X-Genes)
- When using the filter, you can now sort by ascending / descending order based on the quantity you own.
- Bonus Biometrics are always sorted at the top.

 

 

4. Giant Boss Raid: The following improvements have been made.
- The process for creating a lobby or using quick start has been changed. You will now form your team first before entering the lobby.
- The function remains the same as before if you receive an invitation to a Giant Boss Raid.
- The effect of the Giant Boss Raid Co-op Skill button has been improved to a buff that increases skill damage for a certain period.

 

 

5. Timeline Battle & Otherworld Battle: Speed Battle feature has been added.

 

6. Epic Quest & Daily Challenge: The clear condition for specific missions has been changed from "Win" to "Participate" in Timeline Battle.

 

7. Dimension Mission: Get 30 Biometrics (X-Genes) Daily heroes will be added to the “Support Character List” that can be obtained by clearing Dimension Missions, and their appearance rate has also been slightly increased.

 

8. Power Saving Mode Theme: An issue has been fixed so that a “Battle Ended” message will now appear if a battle is terminated due to specific circumstances, such as a network disconnection.

 

9. Multiverse Saga: A function has been added to skip the initial event scenes when you enter this content.

 

10. Emblem Collection: The back button has been improved so you can return to the immediately preceding screen from anywhere within the content.

 

11. Bonus Mission Rewards: A magnifying glass button has been added to check the item list for rewards that are a selector or a chest.

 

12. Main Lobby Gyroscope Feature: A gyroscope feature has been added to the main lobby screen, allowing the hero to move according to the tilt of your device.
- You can use this function by enabling the “Main Lobby Gyroscope Feature” in Settings > Option > Lab.

 


▣ Game Error Fixes


1. Emma Frost <Summer Queen>: Fixed an issue where the model was not displayed properly when moving.


2. An issue has been fixed in Story 5-1 where the battle would not progress due to getting stuck on an object.

 

 

We will return with various content improvements, so please stay tuned.


Thank you.
